Topics · The prophets

Did God only send prophets to the Middle East?

Every nation had a messenger, the Quran says, and it tells of only some.

Part 1 of 4

﴿إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.

Quran · Fatir 35:24

Translation

Yet Yahweh testified to Israel and to Judah, by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”

Original · Hebrew

וַיָּ֣עַד יְהוָ֡ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וּבִיהוּדָ֡ה בְּיַד֩ כָּל־נְבִיאֵ֨י כָל־חֹזֶ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר שֻׁ֝֠בוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֤ם הָֽרָעִים֙ וְשִׁמְרוּ֙ מִצְוֺתַ֣י חֻקּוֹתַ֔י כְּכָ֨ל־הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶת־אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁלַ֣חְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדַ֥י הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃

2 Kings · 17:13

World English Bible

A village on a mountainside believes mail never reaches places like theirs. One morning the postman finds an old letter waiting at a door. No one was wrong to wait. The verse says that in every village and every nation something did arrive, and that it was never a matter of exclusion.

A question for you

What were you taught, or what did you assume, about where God's call has reached?

If you sayOne region and its books only
ThenThat is a common view. The verse speaks wider: there is no nation among whom a warner did not come.
If you sayIn many places, each in its own way
ThenThat is close to the verse. The next verse names what all of them had in common.
If you sayNo one taught me anything about it
ThenThen you begin from a clean page, which is a good place. The next verses are short and ask nothing before you read.

Part 2 of 4

﴿وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allāh and avoid ṭāghūt."[698] And among them were those whom Allāh guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed [i.e., travel] through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.

Translator's notes

[698] False objects of worship.

Quran · An-Nahl 16:36

Translation

Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, “If you are returning to Yahweh with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to Yahweh, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”

Original · Hebrew

וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֶל־כָּל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִם־בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֤ם שָׁבִים֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה הָסִ֜ירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֧י הַנֵּכָ֛ר מִתּוֹכְכֶ֖ם וְהָעַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְהָכִ֨ינוּ לְבַבְכֶ֤ם אֶל־יְהוָה֙ וְעִבְדֻ֣הוּ לְבַדּ֔וֹ וְיַצֵּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

1 Samuel · 7:3

World English Bible

A traveller heads for an ancient city with an old map. In each village on the road an elder speaks of a spring, each in a different language. The traveller is not asked to believe any of them, only to walk and taste for himself. The verse invites you to a journey of this kind.

A question for you

If this was said to every nation, what would you expect to find in your own people's oldest teachings?

If you sayA call to one source above every name
ThenThat is the content the verse gives. You can look for it in your own people's teachings.
If you sayMany teachers saying different things
ThenPerhaps. The verse names one thing all of them were sent with: worship God. You can look for it in each.
If you sayI do not know the oldest teachings well enough to say
ThenAn honest answer. The verse itself asks for looking, not guessing, so the road is to read first.

Part 3 of 4

﴿وَرُسُلًا قَدْ قَصَصْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَرُسُلًا لَّمْ نَقْصُصْهُمْ عَلَيْكَ ۚ وَكَلَّمَ ٱللَّهُ مُوسَىٰ تَكْلِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [We sent] messengers about whom We have related [their stories] to you before and messengers about whom We have not related to you. And Allāh spoke to Moses with [direct] speech.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:164

Translation

I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.

Original · Hebrew

וְדִבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְאָנֹכִ֖י חָז֣וֹן הִרְבֵּ֑יתִי וּבְיַ֥ד הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים אֲדַמֶּֽה׃

Hosea · 12:10

World English Bible

﴿وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِىَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of Allāh. So when the command of Allāh comes, it will be concluded [i.e., judged] in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all].

Quran · Ghafir 40:78

An old library has a small sign on each shelf: this one is catalogued, that one is not yet. The library does not pretend the uncatalogued shelves are empty. It only tells you honestly where its knowledge ends. That is what the verse does on the subject of messengers.

A question for you

What do you make of a book that says it has not told you everything?

If you sayIt shows honesty
ThenThe verse sets a limit on itself here: it does not name whom it has not named. We do the same here.
If you sayIt leaves too much open
ThenPerhaps. The honest reply is that some questions have no complete answer, and this is one of them.
If you sayIt leaves my own tradition's teachers to speak for themselves
ThenThe verse leaves that door open and does not fill it. It does not take your teachers from you, and it does not hand them a title it never gave.

Part 4 of 4

﴿وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ ۖ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allāh sends astray [thereby] whom He wills[649] and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

Translator's notes

[649] i.e., those who refuse His guidance.

Quran · Ibrahim 14:4

A mother whispers to her child in her first language when he is afraid, and he calms. All the words in the world do not do what those words do. The verse says the one who sent each messenger in his people's tongue knew this door: the one that opens when you are addressed in the language that knows you.

A question for you

What would you look for, to know whether such a message reached your people?

If you sayA teaching that sets the One above every name
ThenThat is what the verses say of the message's content. If you find it, you have found something that matches what is described.
If you sayA teaching about justice and mercy toward others
ThenThat is among the fruits of the message the Quran mentions in many places, and it is seen in life before it is seen in books.
If you sayA way of life that matches what the teacher said
ThenThat is a sign that needs no book: that deeds match words. The Quran itself asks this of anyone who speaks (61:2).

The same in the other books

Translation

“Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh. If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”
